deadline.value: Applications close December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027 entry. The master's (MSE) is not accepted for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply for Fall 2027 admission is December 15, 2026.

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires or accepts the General GRE.
gre_general.quote: We are no longer either requiring or accepting GRE general exam scores.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Doctoral students pay no tuition and receive a stipend for the standard five-year term; first-year students get a Graduate School fellowship.
funding.quote: With rare exceptions, all graduate students pay no tuition and receive livable stipends.

also.quote: Doctoral students pay no tuition and receive a stipend for the standard five-year term of the Ph.D. program

entry_route.value: The page says applicants typically have a degree in CS, engineering, science or mathematics, but not whether a master's is needed.

english_waiver.value: CS exempts English-medium undergraduate education only with the institution's certification; the older FAQ lists exempt countries, which does not include India.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants whose undergraduate instruction is entirely in English as certified by the institution and for whom the degree will be awarded prior to anticipated enrollment at Princeton.

also.quote: All other applicants must submit valid TOEFL or IELTS scores

notes: Conflict on English exemptions: the current admissions page and the older CS FAQ differ on which undergraduate degrees are exempt. Both quotes kept. The FAQ's deadline (December 15, 2025) is for the earlier cycle; the admissions page gives the Fall 2027 date. The MSE (master's) is not accepted for Fall 2027.
